subject: North Korea
note: Cited to pinned Wikipedia revisions (trusted_secondary): Energy in North Korea (quoting the World Bank), Pyongyang, Seoul. The picture is NASA VIIRS Black Marble (annual, 2016; GIBS offers 2012 and 2016 only). It shows light at night; it is not a measure of population, wealth or the causes of dark areas, and the script says so.

claims.text: According to The World Bank, in 2021, 52.63% of North Korea's population had access to electricity.
Pyongyang, the capital of North Korea, had a population of 3,255,288 in the 2008 census.
South Korea's 2019 population was estimated at 51.71 million, and 49.8% of the population lived in the Seoul metropolitan area in 2018.
NASA VIIRS Black Marble night-lights picture of the Korean Peninsula, 2016 (NASA GIBS).
